about: The voice-over script. Each line starts `offset` seconds after its shot (`clip`, a name from CLIPS in edit/render.py) begins. A recording goes in assets/voiceover.(wav|mp3): one take of all the lines in order, with a short pause between them; sound.py splits it at the pauses. `pronounce` gives the sound (IPA, as the Kokoro voice reads it) for names the voice would otherwise say wrongly; the captions keep the spelling.

lines.text: Start with a topic you already have.
Or, if you don't have one, it searches creative-industry sites and suggests one.
Then it researches real sources, plans the piece, and writes the draft.
It briefs and paints a cover for the story.
One click publishes it to the Designally Knowledge Hub.
